paragraphs.notes: A four-column list of two-letter PCT state codes and their German country names, transcribed row by row exactly as printed, cells separated by ' | '. Codes run alphabetically down each column, so the printed rows mix unrelated entries. Three entries wrap onto a second line (MK Die ehemalige jugoslawische / Republik Mazedonien; KP Demokratische Volksrepublik / Korea; US Vereinigte Staaten von / Amerika); the continuation line is recorded with an empty code cell in the following row. The fourth column ends at ZW, so the last seven rows have only three columns.
